calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, s.format, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
  SUM(net_amount) AS sold_net, SUM(r.refund_net) AS ref_net, COUNT(r.sales_line_id) AS returned_lines, MAX(r.n) AS max_returns_per_line,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(net_amount),3) AS pct, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date)
FROM sold l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ROLLUP(format) ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, s.format, f.sale_date, f.etl_loaded_at, w.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT l.format, COALESCE(l.status,'store') AS status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net, SUM(r.refund_net) AS ref_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > l.net_amount + 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_refund,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > l.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_qty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date < l.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ret_before_sale,
  MAX(r.return_date) AS last_return, MIN(l.net_amount) AS min_net, SUM(CASE WHEN l.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM sold l LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'multi_format_stores' AS chk, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS val FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT format)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'formats', STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(format,'NULL'), ',') FROM dim_store
UNION ALL SELECT 'control_before_returns_physical', CAST(SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS VARCHAR) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'control_before_returns_web', CAST(SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS VARCHAR) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores_in_period_by_format', STRING_AGG(format||':'||n, ',') FROM (SELECT s.format, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
